text: Cyanogen is perhaps the deadliest poison known. In nineteen ten, it was found in the tail of Halley's comet. And Earth would fly through it.
Papers spread the claim that the gas may snuff out life upon the earth.
Papers reported comet pills for sale. One every hour, until the comet left.
May eighteenth came. Not one instrument showed the slightest change.
A day later, the director at Mount Wilson said: I do not know whether the earth passed through the tail, or not.
The astronomer blamed for the scare had already written: so rarified as to be inoffensive. The deadliest poison known, too thin to matter.
